text: D15 DISCOVERED (user prompted: deepagent middlewares never flagged). factory.py uses deepagents.create_deep_agent v0.6.10 which injects write_todos + file tools + execute + task subagents AND appends its own scaffold prompt after ours — paper sentence all models ran under the rules-only prompt of Section 3 is false as written. Trace audit of all 200 episodes: file/execute/subagent tools never used; write_todos differential — sonnet 38/50 seeds (82 calls), gpt 13/50 (27), deepseek 2/50 (3), grok 0/50 — uptake order matches the skill ranking; deepagents default model is claude-sonnet (same-family harness-tuning objection). Sonnet skill 0.516 todo-seeds vs 0.424 without (descriptive, confounded). Also measured: per-seed skill~port_block_longest Spearman weak (+0.153 sonnet / +0.277 gpt / -0.045 deepseek / -0.030 grok, n=49) — skill-by-group contrasts are NOT duration-driven, unlike KDR; de-grouping applies cleanly to belief metrics only. Fix options ledgered in DEFECTS.md D15: disclose-only vs clean-harness pilot (2 models x few seeds) vs full rerun; recommendation = pilot first, pairs with D14 pinning + repeats ablation in one spend.
